description: Privacy gate at the export boundary. Wraps the out-of-repo V2 scanner (scan_output_leak.py): owner_internal exports are informational (never blocked); employee/client/external exports must PASS or the export is HELD (export_leak_blocked). An unavailable scanner or an unsupported format is treated as UNSCANNED = fail-closed, never an implicit pass. Internal DB and bank WPS are owner/bank documents, not a third-audience export.

fields.description: Reference to the file/artifact being exported.
fields.label: Export Reference

fields.description: The audience the artifact leaves the system for. Only owner_internal is exempt from the block; every other audience must pass the scan.
fields.label: Audience

fields.description: The out-of-repo V2 leak scanner reused (not reimplemented) by the gate.
fields.label: Scanner

fields.description: Arguments passed to the scanner (e.g. --audience client).
fields.label: Scanner Args

fields.description: Scan verdict. Anything other than an explicit pass HOLDS the export (fail-closed).
fields.label: Verdict

fields.description: Scanner findings when the export is blocked.
fields.label: Findings

name: Export Leak Scan
